result.title: MATE4D: Matrix-Guided Editable 4D Generation from a Single Image
result.summary: Generative models have rapidly pushed content creation be-yond 2D imagery toward dynamic 3D and 4D scene synthesis. Yet pro-ducing realistic and temporally stable 4D content from a single image is still difficult because one view provides limited structural cues and weak motion evidence. We introduce MATE4D, a framework that converts one input image into editable dynamic 4D content. Our method constructs a spatio-temporal multi-view image matrix with text-guided background manipulation, delivering coherent supervision over viewpoint, appear-ance, and motion. These synthesized observations are used to optimize 3D Gaussian primitives, which are then animated through a lightweight deformation module to form a 4D representation. The resulting scenes preserve geometry more faithfully, maintain smoother temporal behavior, and keep background edits more consistent, reducing context ambiguity and motion artifacts. Experiments on Objaverse-XL and Diffusion4D show that MATE4D outperforms strong baselines in visual quality, effi-ciency, and controllability, supporting practical AR/VR content creation.

AI.brief_summary: MATE4D 提出从单张图像生成可编辑动态 4D 内容的框架：用文本引导构造时空多视图图像矩阵作为监督，优化 3D Gaussian 基元并经轻量形变模块动画化。
AI.relevance_reason: 研究目标是 4D 内容生成与 AR/VR 创建，其「矩阵」为多视图图像监督而非推理期 latent 状态，未涉及 VLM 推理、证据获取或停止决策，缺少与 LVR 主线的实质联系。
